decisions.reason: It remained a standalone offering through 2024, which suggests performance at or above aspiration levels for a core-adjacent product and gives little reason to reallocate its platform-based resources.

Its downgrade from a dedicated page to a website mention signals results below initial aspirations, but because it is close to the firm’s established tariff and calculation business, management would likely keep it while trying to absorb it into the broader platform.

Although its visibility fell in 2024, the tool builds on existing data and process capabilities, so available organizational slack and complementarities with the core platform make retention more likely than exit for now.
